title: Teodoro questions China’s call for prudence on maritime issues

blocks.text: OROQUIETA CITY, Misamis Occidental, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Wednesday questioned Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi’s call for the Philippines to exercise prudence in its words and actions on maritime issues, saying Manila was merely telling the truth. “We’re just telling the truth. What is prudence? Tell a lie?” Teodoro told reporters
